input.title: Aventon Level 4 ADV
input.descriptionHtml:
Aventon Level 4 ADV mid-drive commuter ebike - Step Over & Step-Through available by special order. Ultro S motor, 100Nm torque, 110-mile range, Shimano CUES 10-speed with E-Shifter & Autoshift, 100mm

Aventon Level 4 ADV
Mid-Drive Commuter Ebike

 

The Aventon Level 4 ADV takes the Level platform into mid-drive territory with Aventon's Ultro S motor - 100Nm of torque, 750W peak power, and an 800Wh Samsung 21700 battery delivering up to 110 miles of range. Where the Level 4 REC is a capable hub-drive commuter, the ADV is built for riders who want a more natural, refined pedaling feel and a smarter drivetrain. Shimano CUES 10-speed with Aventon's E-Shifter and Autoshift technology manages gear changes automatically based on your cadence, and Uphill Start Assist keeps the bike stable when pulling away on a grade. A 100mm travel suspension fork and suspension seatpost handle road imperfections, and the bike ships as Class 1 with the option to add a throttle and unlock Class 2 or Class 3 operation. Both frame styles are available by special order at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL.

The ACU connected platform delivers 4G/GPS tracking, integrated rear wheel e-lock, unusual activity detection and alerts, Hold Mode, and Apple Watch connectivity - all managed through the Aventon app. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Level 4 ADV is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email ebikes@questwatersports.com.

Frame styles & fit:

  • Step Over - Matte Black or Camouflage - Medium (5'3"-5'10") / Large (5'10"-6'4") / Extra Large (6'4"-6'7")
  • Step-Through - Matte Black or Haze - Regular (4'11"-5'7") / Large (5'7"-6'1") - 417mm standover height
 

Included with every Level 4 ADV:

  • Rear rack (integrated)
  • Full fenders, front and rear (integrated)
  • Integrated front and rear lights
  • Suspension seatpost (50mm travel)
  • 9/16" composite platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger
 

Note: Throttle is compatible but not included. Adding a throttle converts the bike to Class 2.


Specs:
Motor Aventon Ultro S Mid-Drive - 100Nm, 750W Peak
Battery 36V, 20Ah, 800Wh - Removable, Samsung 21700 58E cells
Range Up to 110 miles (est.)
Charge Time 5 hours (0-100%)

Seatpost Aventon Suspension Seatpost - 30.9mm, 50mm Travel
Wheels 27.5" Double Wall Aluminum, 36H
Tires Kenda K1052 27.5" x 2.2"
Brakes Tektro HD-M3120 2-Piston Hydraulic Disc - 180mm rotors, front & rear
Drivetrain Shimano CUES 10-Speed - E-Shifter - Autoshift - 11-39T Cassette - 48T Chainring
Smart Features Uphill Start Assist, E-Shift, Autoshift, Ride Tune, 4G/GPS, Unusual Activity Detection, E-Lock, Hold Mode, Remote Notification, Apple Watch
Ebike Class Class 1 (Convertible to Class 2 or Class 3)
Throttle Compatible, not included
Step Over Colors Matte Black, Camouflage
Step-Through Colors Matte Black, Haze
Step Over Fit Medium 5'3"-5'10" / Large 5'10"-6'4" / Extra Large 6'4"-6'7"
Step-Through Fit Regular 4'11"-5'7" / Large 5'7"-6'1"
Weight 61 lbs
Weight Capacity 330 lbs
Water Resistance IPX6 (bike) / IP67 (motor)
Safety Cert. UL 2849 Certified
Availability Special Order - typically 1-2 weeks
